deadline.value: The physics page lists the start as any time, and the doctoral admission page says applications can be made at any time.

also.quote: You may apply and be admitted at any time.

gre_subject.value: The physics page mentions no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Applicants must already have found an open doctoral position in one of the department's research groups.
supervisor.quote: You have already found an open doctoral position in one of our research groups.

funding.value: The physics page describes doctoral positions but does not say whether they are funded.

entry_route.value: A Master of Science or Diploma is listed as a requirement for doctoral study in physics.
entry_route.quote: Degree as Master of Science or Diploma

notes: The 2013 English translation of the physics doctoral regulations (https://www.imp.fu-berlin.de/fbv/prom-habil/Promotionsordnungen/Promotionsordnung-Physik-2013-engl_.pdf) asks for B1 English for an English dissertation, but it predates the 2023 amendment, so it is not used. Amendment (German) not fetched.
